tools.name: action1_list_organizations
tools.description: List the Action1 organizations these API credentials can reach, with their ids. Call this first: most other tools need an organization id. Action1 API: GET /organizations.

tools.name: action1_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the settings and roles of the user behind these API credentials. Use it to check what the credentials can see. Action1 API: GET /me.

tools.name: action1_search
tools.description: Search endpoints, software and other Action1 objects in one organization by text. Action1 API: GET /search/{orgId}.

tools.name: action1_list_endpoints
tools.description: List the managed endpoints (computers) of one organization or of all organizations, with status, OS, last-seen time and update state. Filter by status, update state, OS or reboot need. Action1 API: GET /endpoints/managed/{orgId}.

tools.name: action1_get_endpoint
tools.description: Get one managed endpoint: name, OS, hardware, agent version, last seen and status. Action1 API: GET /endpoints/managed/{orgId}/{endpointId}.

tools.name: action1_list_endpoint_groups
tools.description: List the endpoint groups (dynamic or manual sets of endpoints) of one organization. Action1 API: GET /endpoints/groups/{orgId}.

tools.name: action1_list_group_endpoints
tools.description: List the endpoints in one endpoint group, with the same filters as action1_list_endpoints. Action1 API: GET /endpoints/groups/{orgId}/{groupId}/contents.

tools.name: action1_list_missing_updates
tools.description: List the software updates (patches) that endpoints still miss, across one organization or all organizations. Filter by approval status and severity. Action1 API: GET /updates/{orgId}.

tools.name: action1_list_package_updates
tools.description: List the updates of one software package and the endpoints they affect. Action1 API: GET /updates/{orgId}/{packageId}.

tools.name: action1_list_vulnerabilities
tools.description: List the CVE vulnerabilities found on endpoints in one organization or all organizations, with CVSS score, remediation deadline and affected endpoint counts. Action1 API: GET /vulnerabilities/{orgId}.

tools.name: action1_get_vulnerability
tools.description: Get one CVE as Action1 sees it in one organization: CVSS vector, exploitability, CISA KEV flag, remediation status and deadline. Action1 API: GET /vulnerabilities/{orgId}/{cveId}.

tools.name: action1_list_vulnerability_endpoints
tools.description: List the endpoints in one organization or all organizations that a CVE affects, with the software involved. Action1 API: GET /vulnerabilities/{orgId}/{cveId}/endpoints.

tools.name: action1_list_installed_software
tools.description: List the software installed across the endpoints of one organization (the software inventory). Action1 API: GET /installed-software/{orgId}/data.

tools.name: action1_list_automation_instances
tools.description: List automation runs (instances) of one organization with their status and completion. Action1 API: GET /automations/instances/{orgId}.

tools.name: action1_list_reports
tools.description: List the Action1 report definitions available to these credentials (built-in and custom). Use the report ids with action1_get_report_rows. Action1 API: GET /reports/all.

tools.name: action1_get_report_rows
tools.description: Get the rows of one Action1 report for one organization. Use action1_list_reports for report ids. Action1 API: GET /reportdata/{orgId}/{reportId}/data.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "action1_list_organizations" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
